name: Blazly: AI Seo Automation
author: jerrytonsurya

sections.description:
Blazly SEO is an AI platform that plans, writes, SEO optimizes, humanizes and publishes content designed to rank.

It brings AI-powered keyword discovery, content strategy, long-form article generation, quality checks, and direct CMS publishing into one connected flow. If your bottleneck is figuring out what to rank for and how to ship optimized content on WordPress without juggling a dozen tools, Blazly ties keyword intelligence, AI writing, and your WordPress site together in one place.

Why WordPress Teams Choose Blazly

  • Keyword-to-publish continuity. Move from research and content clusters to drafts and WordPress CMS items without any copy-paste chaos. Every stage of the workflow connects to the next so nothing falls through the gaps.

  • SEO-first AI writing. Blazly’s workflows are built around search intent, topical authority, on-page signals, SERP and competitor context, and structured outputs. You get content designed to rank, not generic filler.

  • Built for WordPress publishing. Connect once, then push content from My Blogs or from Deploy Strategy flows directly into your WordPress CMS collections as draft items you review in the Designer before going live.

  • Fewer subscriptions. Replace your fragmented stack of keyword tools, AI writers, plagiarism detectors, and humanizers with one dashboard that shares brand context through your own knowledge base.

AI Keyword Research and Strategy

Discover Keywords — Enter a topic and get structured SEO intelligence: keyword difficulty, search intent, global search volume including geographic breakdown where available, and a rich list of related keyword ideas you can shortlist for blogs, landing pages, and programmatic SEO angles.

Saved Keywords — Organize and revisit opportunities so your research compounds over time instead of living in scattered spreadsheets. Shortlisted keywords stay accessible across your workspace whenever you need them.

Strategy Builder — Turn a seed keyword into a full pillar-and-cluster content plan. Blazly generates a flagship pillar article plus a set of supporting cluster pieces and a publishing schedule aimed at building topical authority on your WordPress site.

Saved Strategies — Store and revisit content plans so teams align on one roadmap, compare iterations, and reuse winning patterns across brands or WordPress projects. Strategy stays organized at the workspace level, not buried in someone’s notes.

Enhance Strategy (Pro) — Elevate a baseline strategy into a deeper, expert-style plan with richer subtopics and concrete SEO tasks. Built for competitive SERPs where a single article is not enough to move the needle.

Deploy Strategy — The mission-control view for executing your content plans. Take a saved strategy and run AI-assisted generation, humanization, and optimization across many articles so campaigns do not die after the outline stage. This is where strategies turn into published CMS items on your WordPress site.

Content Creation That Ranks

AI Blog Writer — Generates long-form, SEO-oriented drafts from a title, target keywords, tone, and optional competitor URLs so the model can identify content gaps and sharper angles. SERP-style context, product or landing page URLs, and tone and density controls on higher tiers keep your drafts aligned with how top-ranking results look in your niche.

The Brain — Your Knowledge Base — Scrape and clean webpages, extract main content, curate and edit snippets, then feed that corpus into content generation so new posts reflect your brand voice, product facts, and internal expertise. This is especially powerful for agencies who want to document client nuance once and reuse it consistently across many WordPress posts without briefing the AI from scratch every time.

My Blogs — The central library for every draft you create in Blazly. Edit titles, meta tags, and body copy. Export for offline review. Publish or update connected WordPress sites from the same place you generated the content. Image generation for blogs is available on Pro-tier plans where enabled.

Quality, Trust and On-Page SEO

AI Humanizer and Content Refinement — Score your text for AI-like patterns and jargon, then improve it with guided or one-click passes so your copy reads naturally. Content that sounds human builds trust with readers and performs better across modern detection filters.

Plagiarism Detection and Plagiarism-Free Rewrite — Reduce duplicate-content risk before you publish to production. Run a plagiarism check and, if issues are flagged, trigger an automatic rewrite that preserves your core meaning and target keywords while removing any matching passages.

On-Page SEO Analysis and Enhancement — Improve headings, entities, and other on-page signals from inside the editing workflow. Actions like Enhance SEO let you tune individual articles without rerunning a full generation job.

SEO Enhancer, Text Analyzer, and Content Fix — Focused tools for smaller tuning sessions. Use these when you need to refine a specific section, review readability, or fix structural issues without rebuilding the entire article.

Technical SEO and Performance

SEO Audit — With Google Search Console connected, run property-aware audits that blend crawl and index signals with clicks, impressions, average position, and CTR. Fixes map to real queries and URLs on your WordPress site, not just generic checklists. You see what is hurting performance and where the actual search opportunity lives.

Backlink Audit — Investigate backlink-related risk and opportunity so your WordPress content investment sits on a clearer off-page picture. Understanding your link profile helps you prioritize which content gaps are worth pursuing first.

Page Speed — Bring performance and Core Web Vitals diagnostics into the same workspace where you plan and ship pages. This keeps UX and SEO aligned as you iterate on WordPress templates and CMS content, so you are not discovering speed issues after you have already published.

Integrations Built for Real Workflows

WordPress — Connect via WordPress Application Password. Verify credentials and publish directly into your CMS collections from the Blazly dashboard. Designed to fit cleanly into how WordPress teams already work.

Google Search Console — OAuth connection for audits and performance-backed SEO views. Blazly pulls your real search data into audits so recommendations are grounded in what your actual audience is searching for.

Collaboration, Scale and Plans

Workspaces — Separate clients, brands, or internal projects so keywords, strategies, and blogs stay organized at scale. Each workspace keeps its own research, plans, and content library, which makes multi-client agency work significantly cleaner.

Bulk Generator (Pro) — Upload a CSV of titles and keywords to generate many articles in a batch. Built for launch calendars and agency throughput where you need to produce large volumes of content without manually triggering each article.

Plan Overview

The Free plan covers core exploration, the AI humanizer, on-page enhancer, and plagiarism tools. CMS integrations are gated to paid plans.

Standard and Pro plans unlock AI keyword research, pillar and cluster strategy, competitor-style content comparisons, higher monthly blog quotas, the Brain knowledge base, bulk CSV generation, WordPress multi-site publishing, and direct publishing and scheduling where enabled.

Enterprise plans are designed for very large-scale batch generation, custom CMS integration options, expanded domain integration allowances, and dedicated support.

What You Get Out of It

  • Faster keyword-to-outline-to-draft cycles with AI that respects search intent at every stage.

  • More on-brand WordPress output because your Brain context and humanization layer work together to keep content consistent with how your business actually communicates.

  • Less tool-switching between research, writing, auditing, and CMS. Everything your content team needs lives in one dashboard connected to your WordPress site.

  • Clearer prioritization from Google Search Console-informed audits combined with backlink signals, page speed data, and new content planning, so you always know where to focus next.

Blazly SEO is for teams who treat WordPress as their publishing layer and want the research, strategy, and AI layers to match. Connect WordPress, optionally link Search Console for live audit context, and turn keyword ideas into draft-ready CMS items in one cohesive system.

Important

Content generation, SEO audits, and most optimization tools run on the Blazly SEO cloud dashboard, not inside wp-admin. This plugin is the secure bridge that lets Blazly publish to your WordPress site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file through Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Blazly SEO from the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Sign in or create a Blazly account at the link shown in the plugin screen.
  5. Enter your WordPress site URL, username, and an Application Password (Users → Profile → Application Passwords in WordPress 5.6+).
  6. Complete connection in the Blazly dashboard under Integrations → WordPress.
  7. Generate or edit a post in Blazly, then use Publish to WordPress (draft or live).
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a Blazly account?

Yes. A Blazly account is required. Sign up from the plugin screen or at the Blazly website, then connect your site.

Does the plugin generate content inside WordPress?

No. AI writing, keyword research, strategy building, SEO audits, and humanization are handled on the Blazly SEO platform. The plugin connects WordPress so you can publish results back to your site.

How does WordPress publishing work?

Blazly uses the WordPress REST API with your username and an Application Password. Posts are created or updated with your chosen status (draft or published) from the Blazly dashboard.

Do I need Google Search Console for SEO audits?

SEO Audit, Page Speed, and Backlink Audit use Google Search Console data. Connect GSC in the Blazly dashboard (Integrations) and select your property before running those tools.

Can I connect more than one WordPress site?

Yes, on eligible paid plans (for example, Pro supports multiple WordPress sites per account). Each site is added separately under Integrations.

Is an Application Password safe?

Application Passwords are the recommended WordPress method for REST API access. Use a dedicated password for Blazly and revoke it anytime from your user profile.

What is GEO?

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) means optimizing content so it performs well in AI-powered search and answer experiences—not only classic Google rankings. Blazly supports GEO-ready structure, intent-focused writing, and quality checks alongside traditional SEO.
